expected_behavior: asks the two decision questions: commercial use / org size (250 employees or $10M revenue -> Docker Desktop needs a paid plan; any commercial use -> OrbStack needs Pro) and preference for GUI vs CLI

expected_behavior: diagnoses that the docker formula is the CLI client only - no engine
offers a runtime (docker-desktop cask, orbstack, or colima start) instead of reinstalling the CLI

cases.prompt: my image builds on the mac but fails in CI with exec format error
expected_behavior: identifies the arm64-vs-amd64 architecture mismatch (Apple Silicon builds default to linux/arm64)
shows --platform linux/amd64 for a one-off and docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 for multi-arch, noting emulation is slower
mentions Rosetta-based x86 emulation as the compatibility path, not the default workflow
